clues.it: Elena era nella 6ª colonna e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a un timone.
clues.en: Elena was in the 6th column and in the Galley, but was not beside a helm.

clues.it: Nino era nella 1ª colonna, accanto a una sedia e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Nino was in the 1st column, beside a chair and west of Vito.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 5ª colonna, a nord di Dario e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 5th column, north of Dario and in the Galley.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 4ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a un'ancora.
clues.en: Giada was in the 4th column and in the 5th row, but was not beside an anchor.

clues.it: Anna era nella 12ª colonna e nella 6ª riga, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Anna was in the 12th column and in the 6th row, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª riga, a nord di Olga e in Stiva.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th row, north of Olga and in the Hold.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª riga e accanto a un'ancora, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th row and beside an anchor, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Vito era esattamente una riga a nord di Olga.
clues.en: Vito was exactly one row north of Olga.

clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column and west of Rosa.

clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Elena.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd column and in a different room from Elena.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 9ª colonna, a ovest di Sergio e in Stiva.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 9th column, west of Sergio and in the Hold.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Elena's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 6th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Bruno's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 3rd, column 5th.

steps.it: Solo Rosa può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Rosa is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.
